title: Aggregate router discovery must request/handle aggregated discovery format
answers: Why don't CRDs show up when apiextensions-apiserver is aggregated under the router?
Introspection of resources on an aggregate apiserver fails to list CRD-backed groups
/apis discovery on router misses groups served by a standalone apiextensions apiserver
How should discoverGroups request /apis from aggregate backends?
body:
Symptom: when an apiextensions-apiserver (baas_apiserver) is configured as an aggregate backend, the router's /apis discovery never lists CRD-backed groups, only apiextensions.k8s.io itself.
Root cause: discoverGroups (pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go) called /apis with no Accept header, getting the classic APIGroupList, which on that server is served from a static map populated only at startup for apiextensions.k8s.io -- CRD groups are only ever pushed into that server's aggregated-discovery manager, never into the classic list.
Fix pattern: set Accept to request the aggregated discovery format first (aggregatedDiscoveryJSON + ", application/json"), then branch decoding on the response Content-Type: if it contains "apidiscovery.k8s.io" decode as apidiscoveryv2.APIGroupDiscoveryList and convert to []metav1.APIGroup (apiGroupDiscoveryListToGroups), otherwise fall back to decoding classic APIGroupList -- targets that ignore the Accept header or don't support the format still negotiate down correctly.
Constraints: applies to any active-polling discovery of a k8s-style apiserver aggregated under the router; when converting, versions are kept in the order returned and the first version becomes PreferredVersion -- do not reorder without checking that convention.
applies: pkg/router discovery of aggregate (non-forward) backends polling /apis on a k8s-style target apiserver
says: CRD-backed resource groups don't appear in API discovery on router
Custom resources from aggregate apiserver missing from discovery list
Why don't custom resource definitions show up on aggregated router?
Aggregated apiserver groups fail to appear in discovery responses
API discovery misses groups served by downstream aggregate backends
search: Router discovery of CRD-backed groups from an apiextensions-apiserver aggregate backend requires requesting the aggregated discovery format: set Accept header to aggregated discovery format first (aggregatedDiscoveryJSON + ", application/json"), then branch decoding on response Content-Type to distinguish apidiscoveryv2.APIGroupDiscoveryList (if content-type contains "apidiscovery.k8s.io") from classic APIGroupList. Without this, the classic /apis endpoint on that server only lists apiextensions.k8s.io because CRD groups exist only in the aggregated-discovery manager, not the static startup map. When converting, preserve version ordering and set the first version as PreferredVersion. Applies to pkg/router/aggregate_discovery.go functions discoverGroups, decodeDiscoveryResponse, and apiGroupDiscoveryListToGroups.
